factions.name: Anseria
factions.description: Death to InfinitiCorp! A militant phalanx of the Psionics, the Anseria wants to both free the Psionics and get revenge on the ones that have done them wrong. They are more Vrix friendly than most other factions.

factions.name: Bogeril
factions.description: A loose collection of early settlers in the Alpha Centauri system. Bogeril are renowned for their ingenuity and tinkering abilities. The Bogeril wish to be left alone amd are working towards the return of their leader Sam Bogeril. Sam Bogeril is dead, how

factions.name: Centuriata Warriors
factions.description: In a clone culture obsessed with Perfection, the Centuriata appear to be more human than human. In battle, the Centuriata are brilliant pilots, and show impeccable honor and loyalty to friends and allies, while efficiently, ruthlessly and mercilessly dealing with enemies.

factions.name: Chavez
factions.description: The Chavez were once a minor Terran house who were locked in an economic war with the Montague Famlily.  The current family leader Miguel Chavez chose to go rogue and have become pirates.  Now that they have subdued most of their blood feud, they have set their sights on the Red Dragon.  The Chavez recently attained faction status but have no allies so one doesn't need to worry about losing standing with them.

factions.name: Collegia Traders
factions.description: Recruited from the fringes of Sabine society, the Collegia Traders have one goal in mind: Progen Warriors using Progen Weapons. They have had enough of InfinitiCorp''s galactic control, enough of Vinda's non-leadership, and enough of travesties like the Glenn Treaty, which gave the Terrans the richest weapons-grade resource in the known galaxy - 61 Cygni.

factions.name: EarthCorps Warriors
factions.description: Operating independently of the mega-corporations, the EarthCorps military expands and secures Terran interests through force of arms. With massive fleets and all the resources of the Terran military behind them, they are a force fit to rival any in human space.

factions.name: Free Spacers
factions.description: Nomadic and elusive, the Free Spacers have wandered the fringes of civilization since the early 22nd century. They reject the idea of racial differentiation, preferring to see themselves as free and unique individuals. Rumors persist of Free Spacers who have ventured far beyond the bounds of known space.

factions.name: Glenn Commission
factions.description: The Glenn Commission is the neutral government of Beta Hydri, created by the Gate Treaty of 2298. Governed by members of all three races, it is a social experiment, promoting science, tourism, and exploration within its borders. After the brutal Gate war

factions.name: Good Earth Trading Company
factions.description: Free your mind and your cash flow will follow. GETCo or Good Earth Trading Company was the first mega-corporation established with the sole purpose of interplanetary commerce in 2034, competing with InfintiCorp for market domination and trying to acquire

factions.name: Hyperia Explorers
factions.description: Originally backed by GETCo, the Hyperia Explorers have two mandates in its charter. First, to colonize a new system in order to give GETCo a foothold against InfinitiCorp. Second, to create an explorer class within Terran Society. Hyperia is free of the pseudo-religious overtones of the Sha'ha'dem, and the obsessions and ethical quandaries of the Sabine.

factions.name: InfinitiCorp Traders
factions.description: InfinitiCorp embodies the Terran ideal: pure mercantilism. InfinitiCorp is in constant struggle with its eternal rival, GETCo, in defining the direction of the Terran sphere. Led by the beautiful Lady Isabel deWinter, InfinitiCorp will stop at nothing to control all trade and manufacturing in all of human space.

factions.name: Jing Leung Red Dragons
factions.description: Once a leading tong of the Red Dragon Pirates, the Jing Leung have fallen into disgrace, following a failed coup against Red Dragon leadership.  Seeking to reclaim their honor, they now launch suicide attacks against targets of opportunity throughout human space.  They are exceedingly dangerous and unpredictable.

factions.name: Net-7
factions.description: Net-7 is the largest and most influential News and Information agency in the Galaxy. They are always first to break stories, they always get the juicy information before their lesser competitors, and are on top in that cutthroat industry, and showing no signs of weakness.

factions.name: Psionics
factions.description: InfinitiCorp maintains that the Psis were created by IC scientists for their talents in mining dangerous materials. The Psionics have no idea how they happened, and don't really care. They DO know they are enslaved in the mines of Cygni by InfinitiCorp because of IC's fears about their paranormal abilities.

factions.name: Sabine Explorers
factions.description: The Sabine are masters of genetic science and keepers of Progen immortality. They divide themselves into three major classes: the Versatiles, the Specialists, and the Reclaimers. To a Sabine, perfection can and will be achieved through science.

factions.name: Sha'ha'dem Explorers
factions.description: The Sha'ha'dem are the heart and soul of Jenquai society. These scholars, researchers, thinkers, and explorer monks are the most influential voice in the Jenquai government. Sha'ha'dem, the explorers of the Jenquai, are lead by Merjan Kathrada.

factions.name: Sharim Traders
factions.description: Due to recent events, the Sha'ha'dem have seen fit to build a caste of traders to combat the constant theft of Ancient Artifacts from the Aragoth System. The Sharim are charged with the recovery of these artifacts, which are holy relics, and should not be handled and sold by the likes of InfinitiCorp and the Red Dragon.

factions.name: Shinwa Warriors
factions.description: Formed in the aftermath of the Gate War, the Shinwa are the tireless defenders of the Jenquai nation. They value discipline, duty, and selflessness. Though they are few, they are masters in the art of combat. The Shinwa is the warrior class in Jenquai soc

factions.name: The Alliance
factions.description: A mysterious and secret organization led by the enigmatic Nostradamus Smythe, the Alliance is dedicated to earning equality and freedom for the Psionics, by any means necessary. Strangely, many in the Alliance are afflicted by a new disease called Landauer Syndrome.

factions.name: The Kokura
factions.description: Guardians of the sky. Defenders of Sirius space, they are trying to keep Swooping Eagle safe from the V''rix. Their leader is Grey Feather.

factions.name: The Mordana
factions.description: The One True Path and the One True Way. A Jenquai extreme cult which wants to bring back their leader Mordane, who died in the Gate Wars. Current leader is Daniel Malhouse.

factions.name: The Red Dragon
factions.description: Ruthless, brilliantly organized, and expanding, the Red Dragon tongs are the most effective criminal organization in human space. Fierce discipline and enduring commitment to the group have made the Red Dragon pirates a particularly formidable threat. Cur

factions.name: V'rix
factions.description: S2RV1NTS4FTH21NC32NTS. Wants to force all humans away from the ancient gates both by using warfare and by using humans' own perception of what is frightening (taking forms of large insects and names from the human history of Aztec indians).

factions.name: Scuttlebugs
factions.description: <Added by Tienbau> Bunch of bugs - look after their own but probably dislike anyone else. I''ve added this faction as a placeholder MOB faction so that scuttlebugs won''t attack their own, and will protect them. Just give scuttlebug faction to all scuttlebugs and it should work.

factions.name: Renegade Progen
factions.description: These dissidents of the Progen Republic are united under Proconsul Quintus Seritorius (Former Warrior Class General in the Progen Republic) and Marcus Perpenna Vento (Quintus' Second in Command). Together these two individuals are uniting the remaining "Rogue Progen" and "Renegade Progen" into a formidable force, sharing a common goal, to change "the ways" of the Republic.

factions.name: Progen Combine
factions.description: The Progen frontline for 61 Cygni battles

factions.name: Terran Alliance
factions.description: The Terran Alliance within 61 Cygni standing off against the Progen Combine.
